name: Ring of Battle Frenzy
body:
Aura faint enchantment; CL 5th; Slot ring; Price 24,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This plain ring, typically made of steel or stone, grants the wearer the effects of rage for up to 10 rounds per day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring, rage; Cost 12,000 gp

Identification DC 20
